mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand and business investment, leading to higher corporate earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. Falsification: HOUST rises but SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of such instances.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of months where HOUST increases by at least 1% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% indicates a restrictive monetary policy stance, increasing discount rates for equity valuation and reducing risk appetite, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of months where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) and weak housing starts (HOUST < 1700) signal a deteriorating labor market and consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities with negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in >60% of months meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as higher borrowing costs pressure corporate profits and reduce equity valuations over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of months classified as monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.5%) reflects economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to lower corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. Falsification: UNRATE > 5.5% but SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of cases.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of months where UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1600 thousand units (HOUST < 1600) indicate a cooling housing market and weak consumer demand, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in >60% of months where HOUST < 1600.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO > 105.0) signals strong manufacturing activity and economic expansion, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in >60% of months where INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: An annualized CPI inflation rate above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of months where CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate > 3.0%.
